# David Madali

> Prague-based analyst of the defence industry, critical raw materials and the space economy. Founder of Bohemia Defense and creator of OreOrbit, an open atlas of the minerals behind Europe's defence.

## Profile
- [About David Madali](https://madali.cz/): background, projects, media and contact (Czech version: https://madali.cz/cs/)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidmadali/)
- [BBC News Chinese quoting David Madali as an analyst](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cy8gjpe7xp8o/trad): security aspects of the Taiwanese vice-president's visit to Prague, July 2025

## Projects
- [Bohemia Defense](https://bohemiadefense.com/): independent analysis of Europe's defence industry, security and foreign policy (since 2024)
- [OreOrbit](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/): free, live atlas of the critical raw materials behind Europe's defence and space industries
